stem: In the same month, paid search's CPA per order was €25 and its paid CAC was €50. What do the two figures tell you together?

options.text: Paid search won one new customer for every two orders it was credited with
One of the figures is wrong, since CAC can never be higher than CPA per order
Paid search spent twice as much on new customers as on returning customers
Returning customers cost twice as much to reach as new customers do
